comments: RD RESOLUTION ABLATION (platform_model_server.md step 2), 32x64 (Doppler x Range) leg. Architecture is an exact clone of kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_stemstride1_eltwiselinear.json (stem_stride=1, encoder_depth=1, bottleneck_ch=64, kernel3, dropout 0.1, eltwise_act=linear) -- model family held fixed on purpose, only the RD buffer resolution changes, per the ablation's own 'keep fixed: model family' instruction. Dataset root is NOT a config field in this codebase (train.py reads Paths().get()['KuRALS_CW'] from config.ini) -- before launching this run, point config.ini at the 32x64 dataset: python kurals/utils/set_paths.py --cwr /home/lkh099/datasets_local/KuRALS_CW_32x64/KuRALS_CW --pdr <unchanged> --logs /home/lkh099/kurals_logs. Iteration counts (quant_warmup_iters=15000, quant_freeze_iters=76000) are untouched: dataset length is resolution-independent (same frame count, only each frame's RD buffer size changes), so epoch/iteration arithmetic carries over unchanged. Weight transfer is valid directly via --finetune from the 8x64 checkpoint (checkpoints/8x64_maxpool_0.6122_bc64/results/test_doppler_model.pt): conv kernel weights have no H/W dependency, only feature-map sizes at runtime differ, so strict=True load works with no expand_*.py shape-adaptation step needed, unlike the kernel-size/bottleneck-width transfers in CLAUDE.md.
